question: Where’s the closest restaurant forward of Strawberry Hill, San Francisco, CA in the direction of Oldest Light Bulb, Livermore, CA?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Strawberry Hill%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Francisco%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Oldest Light Bulb%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Livermore%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ), target_azimuth AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(s.geometry, e.geometry)) AS bearing FROM start_point s, end_point e ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, start_point sp, target_azimuth ta WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ( SELECT LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, p.geometry)) - ta.bearing), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geometry, p.geometry)) - ta.bearing) ) ) <= 45 -- Filter for restaurants within +/- 45 degrees of the target bearing ORDER BY ST_Distance(sp.geometry::geography, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
